name: create-verification-skill
description: Create or maintain a repository-local skill for repeatedly verifying real project behavior through its supported browser/app, HTTP/service/API, or CLI/process surfaces. Use when the user explicitly asks for a project verification skill, verification capability, reusable verification journeys, or maintenance of an existing repo-local verification skill. Do not use for ordinary test writing, one-off app runs, or automatically scaffolding a harness because coverage is absent.
